answer_text:
Let the weighted inner product be

\[
\langle g,h\rangle=\int_0^\infty g(x)h(x)e^{-x}\,dx .
\]

For a full degree-three least-squares polynomial, we include \(L_0(x)=1\), so we seek

\[
p_3(x)=c_0L_0(x)+c_1L_1(x)+c_2L_2(x)+c_3L_3(x).
\]

Because the Laguerre polynomials are orthogonal with respect to \(e^{-x}\),

\[
c_k=\frac{\langle x^3,L_k\rangle}{\langle L_k,L_k\rangle}.
\]

Use the moments

\[
\int_0^\infty x^n e^{-x}\,dx=n!.
\]

Compute the coefficients:

\[
\begin{aligned}
c_0&=\frac{\int_0^\infty x^3 e^{-x}\,dx}{1}
=3!=6,\\[4pt]
c_1&=\frac{\int_0^\infty x^3(x-1)e^{-x}\,dx}{\int_0^\infty (x-1)^2e^{-x}\,dx}
=\frac{24-6}{2-2+1}=18,\\[4pt]
c_2&=\frac{\int_0^\infty x^3(x^2-4x+2)e^{-x}\,dx}{\int_0^\infty (x^2-4x+2)^2e^{-x}\,dx}\\
&=\frac{120-4(24)+2(6)}{4}
=\frac{36}{4}=9,\\[4pt]
c_3&=\frac{\int_0^\infty x^3(x^3-9x^2+18x-6)e^{-x}\,dx}{\int_0^\infty (x^3-9x^2+18x-6)^2e^{-x}\,dx}\\
&=\frac{720-9(120)+18(24)-6(6)}{36}
=\frac{36}{36}=1.
\end{aligned}
\]

Thus

\[
p_3(x)=6+18L_1(x)+9L_2(x)+L_3(x).
\]

Substituting the given polynomials,

\[
\begin{aligned}
p_3(x)
&=6+18(x-1)+9(x^2-4x+2)+(x^3-9x^2+18x-6)\\
&=x^3.
\end{aligned}
\]

Therefore the least-squares cubic is exactly \(x^3\), as expected since \(f(x)=x^3\) already has degree three.

\[
\boxed{p_3(x)=6+18L_1(x)+9L_2(x)+L_3(x)=x^3}
\]
